title: Contact a borrower — refuse contact once they promise to pay
narrative: A delinquent borrower can be contacted; KIFF allows the outreach and signs a receipt. The borrower then makes a promise to pay. From that moment KIFF refuses every further contact attempt — INITIATE_COLLECTIONS_CONTACT is only allowed from DELINQUENT or BROKEN, not while a promise is active — protecting the borrower from harassment and the lender from an FDCPA / CONC violation.

steps.description: A collections case is opened (state → DELINQUENT).
The agent contacts the delinquent borrower. Allowed. Signed receipt.
The borrower promises to pay (state → PROMISE_ACTIVE).
The agent tries to contact again during the active promise. KIFF refuses it (state_not_allowed). Signed refusal.
